body:

Anyways, leo might be just a tad down bad. Not like galactic level, but just a little. He wrote a poem. ANTICIPATING THUNDER AFTER LIGHTNING IS SCARY

heading: Sun. May 1. 2022
body:
Goodness. I nearly wrote April 31 for the date today instead of may 1st. MAY FREAKING FIRST! I wasn't planning on writing today either, but I felt a calling. Anyways on to it!

A couple things to just get out of the way, today at church I felt very happy when a bunch of people trickled in during service, including Zak and ethan. It almost felt like the good old days again. Just almost…

I was also not very productive today, but guess what? I still felt great! (kinda)

Ok so anyways me and leo were talking about saying goodbyes to people and how unreal it sounds. Because of him leaving for MIT har har har and stuff, you know. At the time I kinda put up a front, and said oh yeah, that's normal dude, I wouldn't mind saying goodbye to people, that's life, but now that I think about it. Nahhhh. That's actually a little frightening. Itd be pretty bad to never see zak, leo, nate, lokland, edward, ever again. And other people. Just can't think of everyone right now. Even with random people I don't know too well, like all the seniors leaving, it's just an odd feeling that I will never ever again exchange any words with them. So anyways, I just wanted to say that, shoot. Goodbyes are gonna be difficult.

And on to the next topic, I need to watch Howl's moving castle. Ok. This is going to sound so idiotic. For some odd reason, I guess my body decided to be really emotional today. I was playing the howls moving castle theme song on my violin (which is like titled merry-go-round-something, so weird) and SOMEHOW i just ALL OF A SUDDEN shed a singular tear. I do not understand. The composers of that music must have had God himself think of the melody.

After that very embarrassing and incidental incident, I just had a thought. I wonder if anyone will actually look at me the same for who I am. Wait that sounds like i'm becoming gay. Anyways, I was bored today, so i went to my room and just played songs from breath of the wild, songs from pokemon, songs from the random mario kart courses, and songs from random animes. And I loved it. I'm sure that's looked upon as being a weirdo. Ahhh.

School tomorrow. Who are my friends? I'm not sure why I'm asking this right now. There's people I always talk to, but some of them constantly irritate me sometimes. And one day they just won't be in my life anymore, and I wont care. That's not heartless, right? Just facts.

I'm suddenly in a little state of confusion right now, and I'm confused as to why. Ben is confused! He hurt himself in his confusion!

Yeah I don't know. I’m not Leo, too much deep thinking makes my brain overload.

I don't really like Leah anymore, right? I rarely talk to her. But….when i hear leo say that work went well, I get so freaking nervous. Why? “OTHERS’ SUCCESS IS NOT YOUR DOWNFALL.”

I like that quote. It's hard to apply, though.

For some reason, Alex's annoying face keeps popping in my head right now. SLAP SLAP SLAP REEEEEEEEE

Who are my friends, who are my friends, who are my friends, should you be annoyed at your friends? It's ok if you find friends annoying sometimes right? Does it really matter? What matters right now? What's the point of cramming information in your head that you will forget? AP HUG? COMPUTER SCIENCE? BOUTA FAIL IN LIFE? ARRRGHHH

Who suddenly implanted a stress seed in my head? SaTAN? Why are my legs jittery? jitjitjitjit

Who's going to matter in 2 years? Who? How many missed opportunities? What am I going to regret? Panic attack? Anxiety attack? Leah? Do I like Leah? NOOOO i don't, right?

Here's a picture of Chika to calm you down. Ok i'm actually alright though, I just don't know what happened all of a sudden.

I'm sorry if I offended anyone who has actual real panic attacks lol.

Whew

Now i'm taking up space so

My text matches up to the picture

So tomorrow I can write on the next line without Feeling like I wasted a

Bunch of space. Maybe I should write a poem like leo.

heading: Tue. May 3. 2022
body:
Alrightly. So I haven’t mentioned much of any of my dreams lately, but last night I had a super weird one that I think is notable. So basically, I was walking to school down the usual route. But for some reason, when I got to the cross walk, maddie suddenly appeared next to me and asked me what my name was. I forgot what I said, but we talked and walked down to school together. Then suddenly, maddie just morphed into vanessa, but i was dreaming and for some reason my dream-mind didn't think that this was odd at all, so I started to walk the rest of the way with vanessa with no difference. When I got to school, I was suddenly presented with a clipboard. On the clipboard was every Indian in the school. That was weird enough to begin with, but then next to every Indian's name on the clipboard, I could see text that had the script of everything they were thinking/dreaming at the moment. So the text kept changing and stuff. Then for some reason, I got a pencil, and I started to write a phrase next to every Indian's name over and over. Everytime I wrote it, it faded into the paper, so I kept writing the phrase (I forgot what it was, btw) again and again. I think that was some sort of mind-control clipboard, cuz then after a while I could see that every Indian was thinking about the same phrase I wrote on the clipboard. Sooo that's my amazing dream. And now I'm going to take a HOT shower because I am chilled to the bone and writing this with my ice-block fingers is SLOW.

I am now here, a hot shower later. My fingers can finally move at reasonable speeds to type. Anyways, Track = hell today. It was so bad. First of all, it was half raining and half hail, so that was already terrible. Second, it was freaking COLD. Third, it was WINDY. Fourth, we were doing aNOTHER pre-meet workout again today, but I swear EVERYday is a pre-meet workout. This entire season has been doing the same thing over and over and over again, it's getting annoying. I do not find satisfaction in it anymore. But I smoked(ish) the timed 400m today, and for some reason, either I was going faster or everyone was going slower, but on the pre-meet 800m I was ahead of the next-closest person by a fat 100m. But still, there wasn’t much satisfaction in doing it today. I was simply tired, and cold.

And I had to do handoffs and the baton was a literal stick of solid dry ice.

YO. THE LOVE IS WAR MANGA. IS GOOD. In so many different ways then just comedy.

It's got…it just got good.

And ishigami is my favorite character by far.

There's something about reading manga thats ahead of an anime. I understand the feeling of superiority now. Like, I know what's going to happen, you newb, i read the manga, ha! Time to flex on zak.

But oh my the manga is so much better than I thought. It took a TURN. I'm not sure how to put it, I just really like it.

I'm feeling so oddly-emotional right now. Does reading freaking love is war really do this to me? I'm feeling like I need a family of friends so bad right now. Oh my bejesus what is the word for what i'm feeling? I'm feeling so…hopeless and deep. What? What's going on?

The feeling of warm skin all over mine. Just another body on me. Preferably female. Oh man, I would like some of that too.[o]

I don't want success on track. I don't care if I got a perfect score for playing at state. I don't care, half the things I do don't matter. I don't care, what's the point, why? I'm going to die in this world, and until I move on to heaven, what's the point. Why can't life be an anime? Everything works out(ok depends what you are watching but) and it's a journey, it's an adventure, it's not just life and schedule on repeat and doing this and doing that again and again and getting better at it and getting better, there's no end.

You make the best of friends, you love, there's hardships, things can happen that will neVEr happen in real life. There's true meaning, you have irreplaceable value to someone else, someone else is irreplaceable to you. You save people, people will die for you, you will die for other people.

Lit background music will play when you do something cool.

There's no such thing as an ugly girl. (but not important lol)

All I want right now is just to find the right people for me. Just a group of friends that I love so much. I just want an escape to the routine of life. Ok. I want a girlfriend[p]. There. How long will I have to wait, until I find someone, anything? Who/what can I die for right now? Is it terrible, that I can't think of anything/anyone? Jesus help me lmao

I want there to be a place and a group of people I can go to to just enjoy myself, FULLY. I don't want to move aside for Visisht in the halls, because he’s being cut off by our stupid walking routine. I don't want cooper and lokland to fight, and get mad. I don't want to be constantly annoyed by Alex. I don't want Leo to be down bad. I don't want Leo to constantly be stressed. I want the old leo. I want the old all of us. Carefree, having fun, the stuff everyone wants. (but with somewhat self-control and restraint, of course) I don't want to feel like Parker is feeling a little out of place. Why does Parker even sit at our table? He could definitely be cool sitting somewhere else. I don't want Dan to be CONSTANTLY annoying. SOMEWHAT annoying, sure, but oh my gosh that kid is ANNOYING sometimes. I don't want people to say, “oh sorry didn't hear you” when they were just obviously ignoring me. I don't want to do the same to other people. I don't want…

Its too much to ask for, i know its stupid, i know i'm being ungrateful, i know i'm so blessed with everything, i know my life now is nothing to complain about, i know i sound like a weeb-idiot-fool, i know, but

Wouldn't it just be great, though? Ha.

Leo stresses constantly about tests, about what people think of him, and about his accomplishments, about his social skills, and I think it affects his mental health mucho. Or maybe that's just me?

I think the takeaway from this is just: I want to escape this constant pattern of seemingly pointless life, and go on a FAT adventure, and just meet the greatest people on the way. Gonna pull a bilbo baggins. Gonna get hit by a truck-kun and get transported to isekai-land. Gonna find my long lost dad, play a little greed island on the way. Going to journey away, finding a body for my brother, get married to winry while i'm at it. I'm going to see the world with my little army of titans. Gonna join a guild I love, sleep with asuna (hehe just kidding) beat the final boss 20 levels early. Run away and survive from man-eating demons, when I'm only literally 6 years old. Avenge my family who was killed by devil michael jackson. Start the world over when everyone else is made of stone? Not sure about that one. Travel the DEPTHS. Go where somebody has NEVER gone. Become a hokage ahaha ok that ones stupid.

I'm a lost cause, aren't I?

Alright if all the above was cringe, fine, just know that YOU were feeling very very very emotional today, and that you enjoyed writing this very very much. And that you were listening to pokemon music at this moment. And that you were thinking,

Bruh.

Siggghh on to practicing violin now. Yippee.

Also one more thing, i say all of this, but I still am going to work hard in whatever i'm doing. I know that those hopeful thoughts are not an excuse to slack off, and that the big factor of, “dude, this is LIFE, not an anime,” remains, so yes I know. Onto the grind! Or maybe just attempting to play Sootopolis city on my violin again.

I just wanna climb a beautiful mountain, look at the view, sit down, have the wind blow, and just let out a massive sigh.

(let it be noted that I spent about an hour thinking and writing this today. What. a. WASTE. Of time. ARGH!)

Yo I need some happy thoughts here. There's been quite a long streak of depressing strings lately. Cmon. where they at?

heading: Wed. May 4. 2022
body:
Well, those happy thoughts aint coming any time soon, at least not today, cuz I SOLD the bag. I took the bag, looked at it, pondered a little, and chucked it into the stratosphere as hard as I could. I SOLD. I sold the 4x1 relay. So hard. So bad. And I sold for triple jump. And I got a 54.25 split for the 400, but oddly, I wasn’t even impressed with myself. That's what I hate about this. No matter how good something is, a week later, it's trash. It's just terrible. It's an endless cycle.

Today, I was talking to dan and lokland, while walking circles around the track. It was nice, it was relaxing, and just talking was calming. The thing is, though, on the walk, I told them that I kinda thought Alex was annoying, and THEY ALL AGREED WITH ME! DAN SAID HE HATED THAT MAN! Lokland doesn't like him either! He just oozes a sense of superiority and arrogance, and he looks at me like I'm some sort of molecule or insect. And he's kinda rich. Then I went to Anna, and she was like, I heard that about him too! And then I felt kinda bad for saying all this stuff behind his back, cause then when I see him I still turn into all smiles and fun and games.

Also, maybe I am a molecule or an insect, because on the way to the meet today, we passed by some of the freaking BIGGesT NICEST RICHEST houses I have ever seen. I look at them, and I just think, man. What am I even doing right now? They're so rich it's unbelievable. It just makes me feel insignificant.

So moving on, because of the meet, I also had to join A lunch early instead of the regular B lunch. I sat at Connor's table, and it was crowded. And to sum it up, I was pretty much left out. It's such an anxious and tense feeling to be left out. It's scary, it's embarrassing, it's annoying, it's awkward. I say that I don't mind being alone, and that's true, but when you're in the moment, it's not so great. I don't want to fake my way with smiles, acting like I'm enjoying myself, cuz I'm not, and I don't fit in too well with them. But still, even with everything I say, it's still nice not to be left out, you know? I'm just going against my own ideals here. So sad and weak willed I am tsk tsk.

Maybe what I really want is to be chased. I want to get lost, to have someone earnestly drop everything, and come and find me. I want to be alone so someone else can come to get me, not me being the one that's doing the getting. I don't know. Just be loved, I guess, as I've said before. And as anyone wants.

The true, pure, love that I want is going to be near impossible to find, I feel like. It's easier to sleep around, have little flings with so many different girls (well actually not for me lol), but I don't WANT to get b*tches. I just want one. Someone different. Blargh. Someone slap me please. I gotta stop teetering on down-galactic speeches.

It's funny, really, that I got the AP HUG test tomorrow, and I'm just typing away here. I gotta get some sleep, but for some reason I think it's more important to write thoughts down. Because I'm scared that if I don't, I'll forget everything, time will go at 100x speed, and I’ll be on my deathbed one day, thinking, wait. I'm dying already? Where did my life go?

I'm, once again, tired and weary. My eyes are having a little trouble focusing, and my foot is in pain. everytime I bend the foot a little sideways, it feels like BRUH. My legs are kinda trembling in tiredness. Triple jumping a lot kinda messes your joints. I also missed the comp. test for the meet today, so I gotta make that up tomorrow, even though I got another test tomorrow too.

I feel like I had a really good conversation with lokland today, though on the bus, it was the teensiest bit enlightiing. I think I just need a little more Jesus in my life. I just need some guidance, and some faith to know it'll be alright in the end. I'm probably overreacting with everything I say anyways. Life aint that bad. At least I can go home expecting food on the table, when lokland has to literally scavenge when he gets home. His family is for real survival of the fittest in his own house.

heading: Thu. May 5. 2022
body:
You know the little tune that all the slice of life anime plays 90% of the time, the dun dun dun dunnnn, dun dun dun dunnnn chimes for the school bell thingy? The wind was blowing every step, the birds were chirpity chirping, the squirrels were scampering around, and then suddenly, in the distance, I heard that tune, wherever it comes from. The church, I think? It was so odd. In all the 5 years I've lived here in Wauwatosa, Ive for sure heard the tune so many times, but I just never really thought into it much. I even counted the rings that came after, and wow! It matched what my watch said, 5:00. Isn't it funny how I take pleasure in such small things sometimes? It made me happy.

The weird thing was, for some reason I also really wanted to walk home today in the first place. In the locker room after track, I was considering calling mom to pick me up, but I just felt an urge to walk home instead. Choose the right day to do so. It truly is nice to walk alone sometimes.

Oh yeah, I also failed my AP HUG test for sure. It was so bad.

And also maybe I should stop judging people too much. That's no bueno, and very unfair and rude of me.

And also I just watched an RDC video talking about how dudes cant be saying nothing anymore without people just jumping down their throats. No matter what you say, in this day and age someones gonna find it offensive or annoying. True, true. Maybe that's why I just stay silent during big group talkings. Well, other then the fact that I don't fit in.

And also I suck at socratics. People get too into it, and there's always this one person who talks and talks, and even though they definitely already got a 4, they feel the need to just keep on answering questions, so I just get left behind in the conversation. I also always feel so fake and out of place, and even though duh, that doesn't matter cuz it's just for school, it feels so unnatural for me to talk and I just can't do it. So I always get bad grades for those. Unless they’re in spanish.

And also my entire lower half hurts so bad. Once again, the leg pain strikes. darn.

And also, I'm SO EXCITED FOR PERCY JACKSON TV SHOW TO COME OUT! I swear, if I die before that happens, I'm gonna be so mad. If it's a complete failure, I'm also going to be mad. But I got a nice feeling that it's going to turn out well, cuz riordan the man himself is supervising too.

And also i've got MYSO later. I'm so annoyed. I just wanted to sit outside and draw today. And just breaaattheee. Maybe next time.

Well I'm back from MYSO, and I came home with a realization. I am scared of musicians. I am scared of top-level, elderly, super skilled musicians. I am scared of judgy, crazily accurate, pitch perfect no-room-for-error musicians. Tetereting on the terrified level. There's just something so intimidating about them. They only accept complete perfection, they have been relentlessly tortured by their own instructors when they were children too, so they look down at everybody else. They're either aggressive or passive-agressive, or just harsh. They scare me. Maybe some of it is just how many countless hours have been poured into their art, that just scares me. I can't really describe the feeling. Anyways, onto eating my ramen noodles yippee.

It's kinda a bad habit that recently, I've been going to sleep later and later. I've gone from 9:00 sharp to 9:30, then to 10:00, and now usually it's 10:30. I actually don't know why I don't just go to sleep earlier. Oh no. what If i turn into the dudes from the russian sleep experiment?

Oh right, I forgot to mention. That one girl I mentioned a while ago, her name is Wenjing, and she speaks Chinese to me and I get scared talking to her? Well, I'm so sorry, I'm a terrible, rude, hypocritical person, but she is. Is. ugly. Without a mask. To top it off, she is skinny as SKINNY can be. But anyways a senior or junior, whatever, apparently asked her out, and she asked me if she should say yes or no, and i was like, errrrrrrrrrr

I'm really sorry, that was super rude, and I'm pretty much just as ugly so. :( sadness.

heading: Fri. May 6. 2022
body:

I don't want to sound prideful, acting like I'm good enough in the first place that people actually expect me to win, but I understand the feeling nonetheless. I kinda respect her for quitting though. She also is still running now in high school again, but I think she enjoys it. She doesn’t really go to the meets, but she goes to the practices because she really enjoys them. I respect it, I don't know why. Suddenly I look outside the window while I'm eating dinner and the tree buds have started to bloom. I swear they only just started to show miniscule buds yesterday.

I either feel there are prying ears that simply wish my downfall, people who start to not like me because they wanted the praise instead of me, or I feel I don't deserve it either in the first place. Also, it's from a coach, so I don't know the correct response-tone-mood for this type of stuff.

Maybe confiding in a document isn't as healthy as speaking to a human[q], but sometimes I feel like I am the only one that wants to hear my own thoughts. Which actually is just 100% true. Also, the habit is unhealthy cuz I always have to wait really late into the night, and then I just become tired. But the silence and the alone-ness is peaceful.

heading: Mon. May 16. 2022
body:
When your nose is so stuffy, if you close your mouth you will die of suffocation because absolute zero air will come through the nostrils. When your nose is so runny, you will blow through 10 stacks of napkins in 5 seconds. When you have to sneeze so frequently it starts to hurt your head. When your sneezes are so powerful it rips a hole through the tissues. When you have to blow your nose so much that the area above your lip becomes dry, cracky, raw, gross, and painful. When you have to blow your nose so much that the insides of your nose is like a desert. When you wake up in the middle of the night, and your nose is bleeding. When you wake up in the middle of the night, and it feels like you didn't wake up at all, because the sleep was so bad that it felt like you never went to sleep in the first place. When it's a billion degrees outside, and your body is a trillion degrees, but you can't open the window because the pollen will get to you, and you know that pollen is a 2x damage multiplier.. When you feel like you're burning up in the summer air, but somehow waves of ice flow through your body occasionally. When the inside of your mouth/through/airway hurts because of the weird sucking snot thing that you do. When your eyes itch so bad it's painful. When you wake up, and for some reason your eyes are watery, sore, and still itchy. And sting. When every nook and cranny, all the elbow pits and knee-pits and whatever itch like crazy, and so does your neck, and you get rashes. Even on your wrist, from your watch. When you can't sleep a single bit an entire weekend, and you feel terribly grumpy. When you literally forget how to sleep. I'm not even joking. When you constantly feel tired. When sniffing the air even a tiny bit will trigger a series of endless, very annoying sneezes. When you wake up and there is blood in your nails, and you have no clue where it came from. When your ears pop and have the high-altitude feeling because of how much you're blowing your nose. When you decide, ok, I'm going to go to sleep early today to balance out the fact that I can't sleep, but absolutely nothing changes. When your body is so tired that when you can finally fall asleep, it now has taken so long to do so that then it's time to wake up. When it's the middle of the night, your brain is not working correctly, you've had on and off sleep for the past 7 hours, and you just feel so ANGRY for no reason. When you just wanna rip the bed to pieces and scream, and your head feels like mush, and you are not thinking coherently. When all of the above happens at the exact same time and you think, oh wait, I got school tomorrow, then you know-it's allergy season.

And it struck hard this year.

And it doesn't help that the bathroom being remodeled is stirring up a dust storm. Argh i forgot how bad allergies could be.

But anyways, Qingjie graduated college over the weekend. Crazy. And a little bit of the old Leo was finally shown through his current shell.

Oh right, it's my birthday in 3 days.

IT'S MY BIRTHDAY IN 3 DAYS WWWHHHAAATTT???? Not that I'm crazy excited for gifts or parties or that, just that I'm a year older. Yayyyy….

heading: Mon. Jun 21. 2022

heading: Sat. Jun 25. 2022
body:

Vannesa suddenly says that I am creepy. Uh, ok, I guess? I ask her why. She says, because she thought I stalked her instagram. Why? Because I gave Dan a description of one of her posts. Why did I give Dan a description of her post? Because the post was stupid and I like saying stupid things to Dan, its what I do. But how did I see her post? I don't have a phone, right? But somehow I must be stalking her? No, no no. Coincidentally, lokland is scrolling through instagram and sees her story and shows it to me and says, dang what a stupid hangout. So I'm bored in bsns prsnl finace, and notice I havent said anything stupid to dan for a while, so i say something stupid about vannesa’s post. Ok, ok. I explain this to vannesa. Ah but, she still thinks I'm creepy. And why is that? I thought I cleared the instagram stalking thing up? Oh, no. She brings up the topic of how I thought that her and jordan had sex. And then, she brings up the fact of why I asked one of her friends if it was true. Oh, well ok. I can explain this too. In math class, vannesa was talking without a care of who heard about jordan. And I heard, “we fit together very well in bed.” or something along those lines. Now, vannesa denies that, but that still aint the point. She then says, “why did you even listen?” I respond with, well, you talk loud and it's not like it's selective listening, you should've seen the look on my table-mates faces too. And then she says I should just not listen. Am I supposed to plug my ears? I then elaborate and assure her, no, I am not constantly out on the listen for you. I am not constantly thinking about you. You just happen to talk, and I'm there and I hear. I don't like you. But ok, she is not convinced. She asks, “but why did you ask one of my friends about it? I KNOW you asked one of my friends.” I say, dude. It's not you specifically. Ok. I get it. It's not my business. But it doesn't make me creepy. I hear something like we fit in bed well together, it just simply surprises me! Especially since it is someone I know. I don't care if you did actually have sex or if you didnt, its just suprising. It's a conversation thing. Not an investigation thing. Just like, oh, hey did you hear yayadada? Oh, yeah, uh huh yadada and then move on. Her name is not copyrighted. I should not be labeled a stalker just because I bring up her name. Alright, now that I think of it, maybe that last one is a little questionable. I guess asking if someone really did have sex or even talking about it is not right, and spreading rumors or something of the sort. Ok, I'll take that. I don't think I should have asked that. Yet I don't think that deserves creepiness status though. I wanna take screenshots of the conversation. But doc will become too laggy. But maybe UGH she's made me feel self conscious now. BRUhhh maybe I am creepy.

I think I just gotta stop talking. I'll stop looking. I'll stop listening. Might as well just stop existing at this point. I wasn’t even thinking this would happen went I sent dan that stupid message. It was just a stupid message! You shouldn't be thinking this hard about sending a joke. I'm beginning to think that writing in this in the first place is creepy. I've come to 2 conclusions.

One, I'm going to minimize talking. Two, I. hate it. Vannesa. I mean dislike.

Jeez. Makes me mad. And self conscious.

The more I think of it, the more I realize. I do think about weird stuff. Am I creepy…I guess talking about middle aged women named Alice is a little creepy, but legit it's just a joke. Does anyone else think I'm creepy? I know Mara and Sean think I'm scary, at least. I'm not feeling good. I'm supposed to be a nice, quiet guy. Not a stalker. Vannesa said that I was always watching people! Like an NPC! Ok, I do watch people sometimes. But not in a creepy way. Kinda like a judgy way. I hate reputations. They can be destroyed and never repaired much too quickly in regards to how long it takes to build them up. Quote some random wise guy.

Anyways, I played volleyball out in the rain and slippery grass for about 6 hours today. Had a little reunion with the old fuji gang, but it wasn't the same. Ahhh it won't ever be the same…

Oh, and yeah I don't like Leah anymore. She's just there. Too much time spent apart, literally see her once every 2 months. Romance life is only going downhill….

body:

I was biking home after summer school and I was booking it on the last street (cuz a weird guy was biking the same route as me and it was creepy) and then suddenly waBAMO suddenly my left eye starts glitching and i am blind. I thought I was going to be blind forever. But the thing was, after it was out, I momentarily forgot that I said I'd be grateful to God once it was. Like, before I eat every meal from meiji, after a long day's work, I forgot to give a quick arigatou. Yet, those meiji meals are some of the dinners I enjoy the most.
